description: This file defines the Note class and the SyncStatus enum for the notes domain in the frontend project. It includes properties for note details, synchronization status, and methods to create modified copies of Note instances.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note with properties such as id, title, content, timestamps, deletion status, and sync status. Provides a copyWith method for creating modified copies.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new Note instance with updated properties, falling back to existing values for unspecified fields.
